context:
ANSWER to your question (20:29 CST Nov 14), from this item's earlier reply (13 Nov 13:22 CST) and main's GLOSSARY.md read now: nothing is overruled. 'debt' has a glossary home on main (a known gap, or deferred work). 'deferred' is not a step status: the roadmap build only counts steps waiting on you under that word. Main's glossary has no step-status rows yet; step glossary-step-statuses adds them (blocked, folded; PR #3195 also adds queued). The only open question is queued: keep it as its own status (a) or fold it into todo (b). Until you say, the lane keeps queued.
Goal: one name per step status in GLOSSARY.md.
Problem (rule): your 583 a asked for one name per thing, and my brief said to drop 'queued' as an alias of todo. The lane read the code: the roadmap build accepts 'queued' and treats it differently from todo (ready-not-started reads only todo and ready). Dropping it would make the 3 queued steps on the roadmap branch show as an unknown status and fail the build.
Based on (read): KNOWN_STATUS, LISTED_STATUS and TODO_STATUS in skills/roadmap/build.py.
Departs from: main has no step-status rows in the glossary — a adds rows and keeps 'queued' as its own status; b retires it.
Meanwhile: draft PR #3195 waits on the lane lint.

lastAnswer.note: does it make sense to get another new word and if so make the case for it

options.gain: No build break; the glossary matches the code.
options.how: #3195 adds glossary rows for blocked, folded and queued, each with its own meaning.
options.label: Keep 'queued' as its own status (triage's pick, stands)

options.how: Re-set the 3 queued steps to todo, then a second lane changes build.py with a red test first.
options.label: Retire 'queued'
options.lose: A second lane for a small gain.

reply: The consultant's read, 13:39 CST Nov 16 (relayed, not your answer): it also picks the third way, fold the queued steps into blocked, each naming what it waits behind. Why: one fewer status, and "waits behind X" says more than "queued". Risk it names: blocked steps show in the build's blocked list and may nag as if a blocker needs action, when they only wait their turn. Its guard: the blocker named is a step id, and the nag skips a blocker whose step is open and moving. So you and the consultant both lean to the third way. It is not option a or b, and it changes about 22 records, so I have not done it. Say "fold into blocked" and the lane does it (the nag guard comes with it). Item stays open.
short: Keep 'queued' as its own step status?

shown.label: Keep 'queued' as its own status (triage's pick, stands)

title: In the glossary, should 'queued' stay as its own step status, or be retired into 'todo'?
why: Triage took this pick (undoable: a later lane can retire the name); it stands unless you choose b.
